description:
ValueEnv::cloned_value (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs:4804) copies a NativeBoundValue (holding a Vec<Var>) on every read; almost every one of its 8 callers borrows it and drops it.
Shape: callers use value(); a caller that needs ownership clones visibly; cloned_value goes away.
Line numbers are at develop d0c3ae00c. Site-by-site ledger (class, what is copied, fix shape): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/audit-jobs.md, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/audit-core.md, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/audit-rest.md.
Signal: full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves; program output and canonical backend dump identical on the probe; allocation count before and after from /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/measure.sh in the commit.
Removes: each named copy, and any accessor left without callers.
title: Native codegen borrows bound values
